listingTitle: iTouchless 13.2 Gal / 50L Slim Step Pedal Kitchen Trash Can | Odor Filter
listingLines: SLIM SHAPE SAVES SPACE & HOLDS MORE – The narrow, bucket-free design fits perfectly in tight spots like between cabinets, beside kitchen islands, or in small office breakrooms—maximizing floor space while providing full 13 gal / 50 L capacity.
HANDS-FREE STEP PEDAL - HYGIENIC & CONVENIENT — Open the lid with a simple press of the foot pedal, reducing contact and promoting a cleaner environment in kitchens or shared areas.
SOFT-CLOSE LID – QUIET, CONTROLLED CLOSING — Lid lowers gently to prevent disruptive noise, slamming, or sudden movements—ideal for homes with children or professional offices.

DENT-PROOF LID & STAINLESS STEEL BODY – DESIGNED TO STAY CLEAN & ELEGANT — Durable plastic lid resists dents and warping, while the smudge- and fingerprint-resistant stainless steel body maintains a sleek, polished appearance.
BUILT-IN ODOR CONTROL – INCLUDES 1 ABSORBX FILTER — Activated carbon filter neutralizes unpleasant odors, making it ideal for indoor use near food prep or common areas.
PREMIUM STAINLESS STEEL BODY – SMUDGE-RESISTANT & DURABLE — Fingerprint-proof finish keeps the bin polished and easy to maintain.
ADA & OSHA FRIENDLY – BUILT FOR ACCESSIBILITY & STANDARDS — Hands-free design meets accessibility guidelines and supports workplace hygiene requirements.

TRASH BAG RETAINER RIM – KEEPS BAGS SECURE & HIDDEN — Built-in retainer rim holds the trash bag firmly in place to prevent slipping inside the bin, while concealing bag edges for a clean, tidy appearance.
summary: This iTouchless kitchen trash can offers a slim, space-saving design with a 13.2-gallon capacity, perfect for managing household waste discreetly. Its hands-free step pedal and odor-filtering system help maintain a cleaner and fresher kitchen environment.
